events.description: A large group of people collectively dismantle and push a metal barricade across a road, using coordinated force; some individuals carry large signs and banners, and the action involves sustained physical effort against infrastructure, consistent with violent unrest or protest escalation.

After the barricade is moved, the crowd continues to engage in destructive activity: individuals are seen pulling down fencing, throwing objects, and confronting others near the roadside; the scene shows ongoing collective disruption beyond peaceful assembly.

A large group of people are engaged in collective violent unrest, actively dismantling and throwing metal barriers and a large sign across a road, with individuals climbing over fences and moving aggressively in coordinated fashion.
At least two individuals engage in mutual physical combat near the fence line (center-left), involving pushing, grappling, and swinging motions; others surround them without immediate intervention.

A large group of people is actively engaged in blocking a multi-lane road using metal barriers and banners; individuals are seen pushing, lifting, and positioning the barriers across the roadway, with others moving dynamically around the blockade, indicating collective violent unrest or disruptive action rather than a peaceful demonstration.

A group of people is gathered in a street with thick smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) in the background; individuals are raising arms, some appear to be throwing objects, and the overall posture suggests active confrontation or unrest.

Scene shifts to a riverbank/wall area with graffiti; three individuals are visible on the embankment, one appears to be holding a stick or pole and moving purposefully, while others observe—suggestive of continued unrest or dispersal after initial clash.

A large group of people are engaged in violent unrest under an overpass and on a street, with visible smoke (likely from tear gas or incendiary devices) being deployed, individuals running, and motorcyclists navigating through the chaotic scene; some individuals carry flags and appear to be clashing with unseen forces.

A large group of people, including motorcyclists and pedestrians, are seen moving rapidly through a street while thick white smoke (consistent with tear gas or smoke grenades) is deployed across the road. Individuals are running, some carrying flags (e.g., Colombian flag visible in f3), and the scene shows chaotic movement and dispersal under smoke—indicative of violent unrest or confrontation between protesters and security forces.

A large group of people are engaged in violent unrest on a city street, with thick smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) deployed, individuals running, ducking, and moving erratically; some appear to be throwing objects or confronting authorities. The scene shows sustained chaotic movement, dispersal, and confrontation consistent with a riot.

In frames f10–f15, multiple individuals are seen in close proximity engaging in physical contact: one person raises an arm holding an object (possibly a bottle or projectile), others grapple or push, and at least one individual appears to be struck or recoiling. The actions suggest mutual physical combat amid the smoke and chaos.

A large group of people are engaged in collective violent unrest on a city street, with thick smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) deployed, individuals wearing masks and helmets, some holding objects as weapons, and chaotic movement including running, throwing, and confrontation with unseen forces. The scene evolves from initial dispersal across a crosswalk to dense clustering and active engagement near barriers and street infrastructure.

A large group of people, many with faces covered and some carrying shields or makeshift protection, are engaged in violent unrest on a city street. Smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) is deployed repeatedly, causing dispersal and chaotic movement. Motorcycles are present, some used by participants; individuals run, crouch, and confront unseen forces. The scene shows sustained collective violent behavior consistent with a riot.

A sudden, bright flash and rapid expansion of white smoke erupts near the center of the street at ~79.0s, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., stun grenade or tear gas canister discharge). The smoke plume expands outward rapidly in frames f6–f7, indicating a detonation event rather than gradual smoke release.

A second distinct burst of dense white smoke appears on the sidewalk curb at ~81.5s (frame f11), followed by a larger cloud spreading across the road in f12–f13. The abrupt onset and localized origin suggest another explosive deployment (e.g., canister discharge).

A group of people on a city street are surrounded by thick white smoke, consistent with tear gas or smoke canisters being deployed; individuals are walking away from the smoke source, suggesting dispersal during unrest.

A massive crowd fills a wide urban avenue, densely packed and moving forward in an organized manner; no overt violence is visible, but the scale and context (following smoke deployment) indicate a large-scale protest that qualifies as collective unrest.
